Raising Scorch

Scorch is a washed-but-not-quite heavy metal frontman. Keep his meters up and his temper down. Each meter does its own thing:

  • 🍕 Hunger / 💧 Thirst — drain over time. Feed him junk, give him water (or booze).
  • 🎸 Entertainment — drains too. If it hits zero he tries to sneak off and relapse — swat him back with the newspaper or he's gone for good.
  • 🚿 Hygiene — he's gross. Hose him down. He'll hate it.
  • 💢 Annoyance — climbs on its own. Keep him genuinely entertained to bleed it off. Hit 100 and he trashes the room — you clean it.
  • 🩸 Blood Alcohol Level — every drink stacks it. Too high and he pukes (then he's hungover and twice as foul). Push it to the limit and he overdoses.

Withdrawal: let him go bone-dry and the shakes set in — he'll beg for a drink and get nastier by the second. Bad mix: stacking the Energy Drink (uppers) on top of a high BAL (downers) can stop his heart cold.

Overdose = the Narcan scramble. His vitals drain while a syringe bounces around the room — tap it before he flatlines. Each OD he survives, the needle gets faster and smaller and the spiral gets worse.

The downward spiral: every relapse deepens his cravings for good, so a messy run snowballs. Two ways to lose: he walks out the door, or you fumble the Narcan. Beat your survival time.

Heads up: this is dark cartoon comedy about a fictional dude. If addiction stuff hits close to home for you or someone you know, real support exists and it's worth reaching out for.
